blockers.facts: Seed contracts omit imported BI presentation types and SfBiArtifact; seed output schema does not admit sensitivityResultRef. Owner pin now supplies them. Canonical typecheck/runtime-schema proof on WP05 HEAD remains dependent on owner integration. No typecheck was run by reviewer.
blockers.interpretation: A package-wide gate; do not mark all 108 behavioral criteria failed or proved from this single issue. Exact numerical/UI invariants still need their own evidence.
blockers.remedy: Owner/S0 integrates minimal compatible shared contract/schema delta, then CI runs canonical typecheck and operation-output positive/negative tests.

blockers.facts: The pinned shared bi-http entrypoint is identical to the WP05 seed: Dashboard-only composition and BI01/BI07/BI08 description. Exporting the new WP05 factory/consumer does not register BI02-06/09-11 or bind canonical source/result stores.
blockers.interpretation: Component or engine-adapter proof is partial for these composite criteria. No integrated classification until all required producers are reached through the shared host.
blockers.remedy: WP10 registers all exact source adapters, preserves authorized producer selection, and records per-view actual producer/case plus consumer check against the same commit.

blockers.facts: Pinned bi-source accepts only sf and selectionRef and returns a Dashboard overview URL; it does not consume valueId/C17/version/context. The new readBiDestination seam is not registered there.
blockers.interpretation: Local callback identity/focus tests remain useful but do not prove the real detail consumer. The independent period-brush mismatch was corrected statically in WP05 with visualPeriod; its prepared regression still awaits CI and does not remove this outside-owner host blocker.
blockers.remedy: WP10 exposes exact mark re-read/C17 resolution, retains display selection and case, returns to the original focus, and verifies eight real chart-to-detail journeys including restricted context.

blockers.facts: A UI lease test uses actual UI authority/dispatcher, but injected producer/business callbacks and about:blank rendering do not execute native/MCP provider-bound runtime. The preserved host supports bi-artifacts storage but supplies no observed final ContextualBI choice/artifact consumer/reload witness here.
blockers.interpretation: The descriptor, closed schema, direct-call refusal and UI lease can be proved locally. The full criterion still requires production native authority, same base/result/version, revocation/generation negatives and actual resident consumption.
blockers.remedy: WP10 runs UI/native/MCP against the same handler and source binding, produces attributable receipts, rejects direct/ungranted/revoked/provider-swap calls, persists and reopens human-approved artifacts through real readers.

blockers.facts: WP02 current scope.ts (blob f53d0509b6f727947ec9b00888bce9dae1420094) and port.ts preserve the undated milestone/current status and project an absent date. The seed drops undated at both scope and port; a renderer fixture cannot recover the missing source row.
blockers.interpretation: Hard dependency applies to the real-producer undated witness, not to the renderer invariant itself. Do not mark the no-artificial-date invariant failed solely because upstream omits the record.
blockers.remedy: Integrate the WP02 producer delta and run actual planned/completed/undated producer-to-renderer evidence.
